body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in York, United Kingdom. The listing gives its length as 3 – 4 hours, over a route of about 7.0 km. It starts at National Railway Museum York, Leeman Rd, York YO26 4XJ, UK. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Free timed-entry ticket to the National Railway Museum to guarantee entry. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This self-guided audio tour will introduce you to the highlights of the National Railway Museum and the city of York.
>
> Note! Museum admission is free. With this in-app audio tour, you get the audio commentary on your phone along a planned route, and a reserved time entry ticket to the museum that guarantees your admission.
>
> Start the tour from the central entrance on Leeman Road and explore the must-sees of the vast halls, famous locomotives, and royal carriages. Explore the stories, places and engineering marvels behind the railways and see world-changing inventions.
>
> After the museum, the route leads through the city toward Clifford’s Tower and the castle area, then on to the JORVIK Viking Centre, Shambles Market, the City Walls, York Minster, and York Art Gallery. The walk ends in Museum Gardens, among broad lawns, Roman remains, and the striking ruins of St Mary’s Abbey.
